title: Simultaneous rescaling data with the coefficient quotient, before polynomial base change

from.place: Stacks 07FJ steps 10--13 and 15: simultaneous rescaling and retention of the coefficient quotient needed by step 25

proof_origin.place: Lemma 07FJ, steps 10--13, 15; coefficient quotient of step 25

statement:
Let k:Type u be a field of characteristic p>0, A:Type v a finitely presented commutative k-algebra, Λ:Type w a Noetherian geometrically regular k-algebra, α:A→ₐ[k]Λ, and q∈Spec Λ. Put L=Λ_q. Let N>0 with m_L^N contained in the extension to L of α(singularIdeal k A), d=spanFinrank(m_L), a:Fin s→A generating singularIdeal k A, c>0, and n₀=N+d(8c). Fix a surjective polynomial presentation f:k[z_i:i∈Fin r]→A. Fix φ₀:k[y_i:i∈Fin m₀]→Λ and its localized map ψ₀:P₀=(k[y_i])_(φ₀⁻¹q)→L, commuting with the polynomial map. Suppose ψ₀ is flat and the contracted prime extends to m_L. Fix a local Artinian ring D₀:Type(max u w), with a local essentially smooth algebra structure over P₀/(φ₀⁻¹q P₀)^n₀ and a flat local homomorphism g₀:D₀→L/m_L^n₀, such that the quotient diagram commutes and each α(f(z_i)) modulo m_L^n₀ is in the range of g₀. All notions are those of the statement-dependency nodes.
There exist m and compatible k-algebra structures S=k[X_i:i∈Fin d]→R=k[Y_i:i∈Fin m]→Λ, ell:Fin d×Fin s→Λ and rho:Fin d→R satisfying rho_i=image(X_i), image(X_i)^(2N)=sum_j ell(i,j)α(a_j), image(rho_i)∈q, and equal kernels of rho_i and rho_i² on R and Λ modulo preceding (8c)-th powers. For Q=R_(q∩R), L=Λ_q and K=m_L^(N+d(8c)), there is H⊂R with HQ=(rho_i)Q and HL=m_L. There are a commutative k-algebra B:Type u, a local Artinian commutative k-algebra D′:Type(max u v), a compatible B-algebra structure on D′, and a k-algebra equivalence e:R/H^(N+d(8c))≃B[T_i:i∈Fin d]. The B-algebra D′ is essentially smooth. There are f₀:A→ₐ[k]D′, a flat local homomorphism g:D′→L/K, u₀:Fin d→D′, units δ:Fin d→D′ˣ, and coeff:Fin d×Fin s→D′. The quotient L/K is local. Coefficient mapping B[T]→D′[T] sends e(rho_i mod H^(N+d(8c))) to C(u₀(i))T_i. For every z∈R, evaluating coefficientMap(e(z mod H^(N+d(8c)))) by g on coefficients and at g(δ_i) on variables equals z's image in L/K. Finally g(f₀(x))=α(x) mod K and g(coeff(i,j))=ell(i,j) mod K. No R/H^(N+d(8c))-algebra structure or essential smoothness of D′[T] is part of the conclusion.

proof.text: Starting from the given flat polynomial chart and coefficient solution, geometric regularity makes L regular, so its embedding dimension d equals its Krull dimension; the closed fibre of the flat local polynomial chart is the residue field of L. Use the flat height formula and regularity of the polynomial source to choose polynomial representatives of a regular system of d parameters in its source and L. The finite presentation f and generator membership in D₀ give the factorization of A through D₀ by injectivity of the flat local coefficient map.

Put R=k[y,t_0,...,t_(d-1)] and send X_i in S to u_i t_i. Permutations of the parameters are regular in P₀, so the u_i t_i form a regular sequence after inverting k[y] outside p. Successively apply regular-sequence powers and Ogoma on R/((u_jt_j)^e:j<i), multiplying u_i by elements outside p, to equalize the first and square kernels. Earlier equalities are unchanged and parameter generation is preserved.

Inductively construct δ_i outside q and λ_ij in Λ inside an enlarged Artinian coefficient solution D′. Faithful-flat contraction writes u_i^N=sum a_j d_j in D′. Lift d_j into L and correct the error in m_L^(n-N), then multiply by u_i^N so u_i^(2N)=sum a_j w_j with the prescribed residue classes. Choose a common denominator s₀ with w_j=u_j/s₀, and s₁ outside q killing s₀u_i^(2N)-sum u_j a_j. Set s=s₀s₁ and μ_j=s^(2N-1)s₁u_j: then (su_i)^(2N)=sum μ_j a_j and μ_j/s^(2N)=w_j. Enlarge by 07FI to include a positive power of s, replacing s by s^r and μ_j by s^(2N(r-1))μ_j. These replacements preserve both identities; the residue of the new μ_j is (s^r)^(2N)u_i^N d_j in the enlarged coefficient ring. Apply Ogoma on Λ/((δ_ju_j)^e:j<i) and enlarge again by 07FI to include a suitable power (s′)^q. Take δ_i=(s′)^q s and λ_ij=(s′)^(2Nq)μ_j. This gives the relation in Λ, equal first/square kernels, and coefficient membership, preserving earlier conditions.

Evaluate the new variables t_i at δ_i and take H to be the extension of the original contracted prime. The t_i are units in Q because δ_i lies outside q. Therefore the rescaled parameters generate HQ, and HL=m_L by the original extended-prime equality. Retain K=m_L^n₀ and let I₀=H^n₀; do not compare these ideals with powered-parameter spans here.

Put P=k[y] and B=P/p₀^n for n=N+d(8c). With R=P[t_i] and H=p₀R, the equality (p₀R)^n=p₀^nR and the polynomial quotient universal property give e:R/H^n≃ₐ[k]B[t_i]. The finite sequence of coefficient enlargements is essentially smooth over P_(p₀)/p₀^nP_(p₀), and hence over B by composition with the localization of B. The smooth model is a quotient of a finite polynomial ring over B and its localization is a quotient of pairs of elements of that small ring; thus both are small in max u v. Shrink this finite-presentation localization model of the coefficient ring to Type(max u v), carrying all maps and equations across the algebra equivalence; reindex the old and added variables as Fin m. Polynomial coefficient mapping sends rho_i to C(u₀(i))X_i. Evaluation at the included units δ_i agrees with the original polynomial chart on coefficients and each variable, hence everywhere by polynomial extensionality. Retain the flat local map, A-factorization and coefficient lifts. This step does not construct any R/H^n- or S-algebra structure on D′[t_i] or assert that this polynomial algebra is essentially smooth.

rescale regular local parameters to construct a smooth Artinian coefficient algebra in Popescu theorem
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: standard-smooth local charts and Weierstrass preparation; none constructs this rescaling data.
Coefficient-map API only, no simultaneous rescaling construction.

mathlib_searches.results: Only the parent chart and downstream consumers; Mathlib supplies polynomial tensor and quotient equivalences, no rescaling induction. Blueprint search for rescaling coefficient polynomial returned no matches.

mathlib_searches.query: flat local Artinian algebra enlarge to include elements of target with a power of denominator
mathlib_searches.results: Second reading: eight hits about flatness under localization, going down, and formal smoothness; no combined rescaling construction.
Second reading: Smooth.of_equiv transports smoothness along an algebra equivalence; it is already used in the proved parent helper. No replacement for the rescaling induction.

mathlib_searches.results: Second reading: coefficient enlargement and rescaled integral presentation are component results; the broader parameter models depend on this chart and cannot replace it. No existing combined rescaling data theorem or shorter essentially-smooth polynomial transport lemma.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_rescaling_data
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (d : ℕ) (hd : d =
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).spanFinrank)
    (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (r : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin r) k →ₐ[k] A) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (m₀ : ℕ) (φ₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    (ψ₀ : Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) →+*
      Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
    (hψ₀ : ψ₀.comp (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom))) =
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom)
    (hideal₀ : q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom))
    (hflat₀ : ψ₀.Flat)
    (D₀ : Type (max u w)) [CommRing D₀] [IsLocalRing D₀] [IsArtinianRing D₀]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^ (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀]
    (g₀ : D₀ →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      (q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)]
    [IsLocalHom g₀]
    (hsmooth₀ : EssentiallySmooth
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)
    (hgflat₀ : g₀.Flat)
    (hfactor₀ : (g₀.comp (algebraMap
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)).comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c)))) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.asIdeal.map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c)))).comp ψ₀)
    (hinc₀ : ∀ i : Fin r, Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (α (f (MvPolynomial.X i)))) ∈
        Set.range g₀) :
    let S := MvPolynomial (Fin d) k
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : Algebra S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k))
      (_ : Algebra S Λ) (_ : IsScalarTower S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k S Λ) (ell : Fin d × Fin s → Λ)
      (rho : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
    (rho = fun i ↦ algebraMap S (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)) ∧
    (∀ i, algebraMap S Λ (MvPolynomial.X i) ^ (2 * N) =
      ∑ j : Fin s, ell (i, j) * α (a j)) ∧
    (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (rho i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin d)
      (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
        {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧ y = rho j ^ (c * 8)}),
      rho i • x = 0 ↔ rho i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    (∀ (i : Fin d)
      (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
        {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧
            y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (rho j) ^ (c * 8)}),
      rho i • x = 0 ↔ rho i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    let K := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
    ∃ (H : Ideal R),
      H.map (algebraMap R Q) =
        Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦ algebraMap R Q (rho i))) ∧
      H.map ((algebraMap Λ L).comp (algebraMap R Λ)) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ∧
      ∃ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (_ : Algebra k B)
        (D' : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D')
        (_ : IsLocalRing D') (_ : IsArtinianRing D') (_ : Algebra k D')
        (_ : Algebra B D') (_ : IsScalarTower k B D'),
        let I₀ := H ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
        ∃ (e : (R ⧸ I₀) ≃ₐ[k] MvPolynomial (Fin d) B),
          EssentiallySmooth B D' ∧
          ∃ (f₀ : A →ₐ[k] D') (g : D' →+* L ⧸ K)
            (u₀ : Fin d → D') (δ : Fin d → D'ˣ) (coeff : Fin d × Fin s → D'),
            IsLocalRing (L ⧸ K) ∧ IsLocalHom g ∧ g.Flat ∧
            (∀ i : Fin d,
              MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap B D')
                (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I₀ (algebraMap S R (MvPolynomial.X i)))) =
              MvPolynomial.C (σ := Fin d) (u₀ i) * MvPolynomial.X (R := D') i) ∧
            (∀ z : R, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom g (fun i ↦ g (δ i : D'))
              (MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap B D') (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I₀ z))) =
              Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (algebraMap R Λ z))) ∧
            (∀ x, g (f₀ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (α x))) ∧
            (∀ ij, g (coeff ij) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (ell ij)))
